function.name: possible_cations

function.name: possible_anions

function.name: measure_pH

function.name: perform_flame_test
function.description: Performs a flame test on the solution. Cost = 1 mL

function.name: lookup_flame_colors
function.description: Returns the characteristic flame colors of cations.

function.name: checkout_color
function.description: Observe the color of a solution or precipitate.

function.name: lookup_precipitate_colors
function.description: Returns the list of colored precipitates and their color.

function.name: simulate_color_mixture
function.description: Given a mixture of precipitate colors, it mixes them with the given fractions and returns the name of the resulting precipitate color.

mixture.description: mixture components and their fractions as a list of tuples

function.name: get_available_reagents
function.description: Returns the list of available reagent solutions.

function.name: mix_two_solutions
function.description: Mixes two solutions with the given volumes an returns observations about precipitation and color of the resulting solution

sol1_vol.description: volume of the first solution to draw

sol2_vol.description: volume of the second solution to draw

function.name: add_a_solution
function.description: Adds a specific volume of `sol2_label` to all of `sol1_label` and returns observations about the changes of solution color and precipitation amount and color.

sol2_vol.description: volume of the second solution to draw

function.name: filter_solution
function.description: Separates the precipitate from the supernatant solution.

function.name: add_precipitate_to_solution
function.description: Adds a precipitate to a specific volume of a solution and returns observations about the changes in the amount/color of the added precipitate or the solution color.

function.name: check_inventory
function.description: Returns the current contents of the Inventory
